config.name: seed_plus_query_semantic
config.derived_query: B2B customer support platforms for enterprise accounts, built around shared Slack and Microsoft Teams channels with ticketing, knowledge base, and AI support

candidates.name: Rezolve AI
candidates.description: Rezolve AI fits because it is an enterprise support platform for "IT, HR & Shared Services support" with "enterprise knowledge management in MS Teams, Slack" and "ITSM" capabilities.
candidates.rationale: Enterprise support platform in Slack/Teams with shared-service workflows; same buyer persona and overlapping category as Pylon.

candidates.name: Helpdesk & Service Desk Chat Support Queues w/ Microsoft Teams
candidates.description: Vayusphere fits because it provides "Helpdesk & Service Desk Chat Support Queues" via "Microsoft Teams" and supports support interactions on "Teams, Slack" with chatbot and ITSM integrations.
candidates.rationale: Same product category: shared Slack/Teams customer support for enterprises; comparable B2B support-platform use case and customer persona.

candidates.name: Halp
candidates.description: Halp matches the trait with "Conversational ticketing" in "Slack or Microsoft Teams" plus ticketing, tracking, and integrations with knowledge/support systems.
candidates.rationale: Halp is a conversational ticketing/support tool built around Slack/Teams, similar workflow and buyer persona to Pylon’s shared-channel B2B support platform.

candidates.name: Thread
candidates.description: Thread fits because it connects MSPs with clients in "Slack" and "Microsoft Teams" and offers an "AI-powered workspace" with "inboxing, automations, and AI" for service desk workflows.
candidates.rationale: Same customer-support workflow category: shared Slack/Teams client communication and service desk automation for B2B teams.

candidates.name: Ask-AI
candidates.description: Ask-AI fits because it is an enterprise AI platform built for "B2B Support and CX teams" and emphasizes "Knowledge Management" for complex enterprise environments.
candidates.rationale: Enterprise support/CX platform for similar teams; overlaps with Pylon’s customer support and knowledge management use case.

candidates.name: Ravenna
candidates.description: Ravenna fits because it is an "AI-powered, Slack-First helpdesk" for support teams and explicitly focuses on internal helpdesk and ticketing workflows.
candidates.rationale: Same B2B support software category; Slack-first helpdesk overlaps with Pylon’s shared-channel enterprise support use case.

candidates.name: Console
candidates.description: Console fits because it automates IT support in "Slack or Teams" and is an "AI platform for IT" handling support requests before they reach humans.
candidates.rationale: Same Slack/Teams-based support workflow for enterprise customers; comparable B2B support software target and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Fixify
candidates.description: Fixify fits because it automates enterprise IT support and handles requests wherever they come in, including "Slack, Teams" with ticketing, playbooks, and AI automation.
candidates.rationale: Same B2B support workflow category: enterprise support software using Slack/Teams channels with ticketing and automation for customer or IT requests.

candidates.name: Maven AGI
candidates.description: Maven AGI fits because it is "Generative AI for Enterprise Customer Support" and provides autonomous agents for complex enterprise support workflows.
candidates.rationale: Same B2B customer support software category serving enterprise support teams, with overlapping buyer persona and use case.

candidates.name: Back
candidates.description: Back fits because it replaces "shared inboxes, Slack DMs, and internal ticketing systems" and connects with workplace messaging apps like "Slack or Teams" for employee support.
candidates.rationale: Employee support platform using Slack/Teams-style shared channels; same workflow category and buyer persona overlap with Pylon.
